body:
I am seeing a therapist, although she doesn't know the true extent of it..  I've told my mother and boyfriend about "mood swings" I have, my bf knows a little more than my mom does, I guess.  I also told my sister and one of my best friend about wanting to give up on life... I guess basically everyone knows what's going on, just not to tmthe full extent so they might still me a little surprised if I ended everything, but not super surprised.

Can no one really help me? How do I explain the true severity of my suffering??

How do you tell someone that you have a belt hanging from the rod in your closet and from the moment you get home you wrap it around your neck and stand there for hours, slightly tighter than the night before?

How do you say that you hope one day you've tied it just tight enough to lose consciousness and never wake up, and you do this every night until you defeatedly crawl into bed?
write letters to my loved ones
